# Kadir Lofca

> Software engineer specializing in mobile development (Flutter/iOS/Android), AWS cloud infrastructure, and interactive/XR applications. Founder of Sentzel Labs. Based in Raleigh, NC, USA.

Kadir Lofca is a software engineer with a B.S. in Computer Science from the University of North Carolina at Greensboro (2024). He builds consumer and enterprise products at global scale, with deep expertise in cross-platform mobile development, cloud backend systems, and AI-powered platforms. He is the founder of Sentzel Labs and won Best 3DUI Contest Award at IEEE VR 2023 in Shanghai for published XR authentication research.

## Experience

### Software Engineer — D2Sol Inc. (June 2025 – Present) | Raleigh, NC

D2Sol builds government benefits platforms. Kadir leads mobile engineering for mission-critical applications serving 300,000+ citizens across two US states.

- Spearheaded delivery of mobile applications for two US states, ensuring scalable access for 300,000+ citizens
- Reduced estimated development costs by 70% by architecting a unified Flutter codebase with 99% code sharing across iOS, Android, and multiple government clients
- Architected a Flutter Hosted Server Driven UI system using MVVM to decouple logic from presentation, enabling dynamic tenant configuration across iOS, Android, and Web
- Secured PII data and reduced average login duration by 80% via Biometric Authentication (FaceID/TouchID) and encrypted Keychain storage
- Hardened mobile security with OAuth 2.0 + PKCE, Certificate Pinning, and App Attestation against man-in-the-middle attacks
- Delivered real-time alerts to 300,000+ devices via a serverless Notification Service using AWS Lambda, SQS, and DynamoDB
- Eliminated 90% of routine App Store update cycles with a custom Hot-Update Remote Configuration engine
- Achieved 60fps scrolling performance on low-end hardware via reactive state management minimizing widget rebuilds
- Built a Hybrid Web-Native bridge for zero-friction sessions within legacy government portals
- Implemented dynamic caching localization for instant language switching across multiple locales
- Established CI/CD pipeline with automated integration, unit, and widget tests for critical user flows

### Founder & Engineer — Sentzel Labs (May 2025 – Present) | Remote

Sentzel Labs is an AWS-funded startup building Juxta.gg, an AI-powered game intelligence and discovery platform in production.

- Architected and shipped juxta.gg end-to-end as sole engineer using Hono, Astro/Svelte, PostgreSQL, and pgvector
- Engineered a 10-activity durable AI ingestion pipeline on Temporal.io: YouTube transcript ingestion → aspect extraction via AWS Bedrock → pgvector deduplication → ELO ranking via LLM pairwise comparison → description generation → DB commit
- Built hybrid semantic search delivering <500ms results combining ILIKE text scoring with pgvector HNSW-indexed cosine similarity over 1024-dim Amazon Titan V2 embeddings
- Designed an AI-adjudicated ELO ranking system using Amazon Nova Lite via AWS Bedrock with authority-weighted K-factor scaling and full audit log
- Provisioned all cloud infrastructure via Pulumi IaC (EC2, ECR, S3, IAM) with SSH-less deployment via AWS SSM
- Enforced 26 codebase quality rules across 263 TypeScript source files with a custom guidelines test suite and 90% coverage gate
- Authored 32 REST API endpoints covering game stats, aspect intelligence, ELO trajectories, head-to-head comparisons, and embedding landscape visualization
- Stack: TypeScript, Hono, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL 16, pgvector, Temporal.io, PgBouncer, Astro, Svelte, AWS Bedrock, Pulumi, Docker, GitHub Actions

### Programming Mentor — Stiegler EdTech (November 2023 – June 2025) | Charlotte, NC

- Led technical education for 200+ students, achieving 100% pass rate via targeted C++ remediation plans
- Mentored 15+ junior teaching assistants on pedagogy and debugging
- Directed Arduino-based robotics projects involving real-time sensor integration and PID control loops
- Mitigated LLM hallucinations by 30% in automated assessments by architecting evaluation benchmarks for a custom AI grading system
- Reduced student debugging time by ~40% by systematizing common low-level failure patterns into a shared knowledge base

### Software Engineering Intern — Genesys Cloud (August 2023 – November 2023) | Durham, NC

Genesys Cloud is a global customer experience platform serving 2,000,000+ customers.

- Engineered full-stack features for a high-traffic screen-sharing application using Next.js, TypeScript, and Redux
- Reduced infrastructure provisioning time by 50% via reusable Terraform modules
- Decreased regression bugs by 20% with 30+ unit and integration tests in Docker/Redis CI environments
- Optimized backend API endpoints for 99.99% availability and <200ms response times
- Ensured 100% HIPAA Security and Privacy compliance

### VR Researcher & Software Engineer — UNC Greensboro (February 2021 – August 2023) | Greensboro, NC

- Achieved <1mm tracking accuracy for VR experiments by engineering a controlled environment to resolve IR tracking interference
- Eliminated 10+ hours/week of manual data entry with a custom C# Unity telemetry logging plugin
- Enabled physical-virtual interaction with <5ms latency using Leap Motion and HTC Vive Trackers
- Co-authored 2 research papers presented at IEEE VR 2022 and IEEE VR 2023, cited by 14+ subsequent studies
- Validated research on human time perception via human-subject trials with 20+ participants

## Projects

### IEEE VR 2023 XR Authentication — Award Winner
Novel two-factor authentication framework for XR using continuous motion-matching, haptic TOTP delivery, and Morse code OTP input. Won Best 3DUI Contest Award at IEEE VR 2023 in Shanghai, China. Published on IEEE Xplore.
Publication: https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/10108572/

### Santai.GG
High-performance open-source game statistics platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase (PostgreSQL), and Redis. Grew to 300+ weekly active users within 3 months.
